title: Audio Object Editing V1.0

Identifier.AIMName: /* The name of the AIM, given by the concatenation of the two strings ImplementerID and ImplementationID, in this order, with no space and no character between them. */

Description: Audio Object Editing. One Audio Object is open at a time, so a User Command need not name it: the Audio Object that the User Command gives (AcquiredObject), in full or by its name, is opened - from Shared Storage - or, new (a sound the User Agent captured), created. The User Command modifies what it is like (ModifiedObjects: the Object part of the Acoustic Profile; LUFS) and where it is heard from (UserPoV). It changes the features of the Objects it keeps, each by a value (ChangedObjects): of an Audio Object its Name, Time, SpaceTime, UserPoV, ParentAudioObjectIDs, DescrMetadata and the SpaceTime of each child, named; of a Basic Audio Object its Name, Time, UserPoV, DeviceID, Level, PerceptStatus, AcousticProfile, AudioQualifier and DescrMetadata. The sound is not edited. A new Name is the Object's new name, which stays unique. The list it gives (ListedObjects) says of each Object its Kind, Duration, number of children and Version. Every edit is a new version in Shared Storage. Outputs: the open Audio Object, to the Module and to Audio Scene Editing, and the User Command, with its response (UserCommandRS) saying how each action was executed.
